description: Step 4 of Open Commerce Pathways: authorize one AI planning run by our default compute agent, $0.02 in USDC on Base over x402, usable within 1 hour. Called without payment, it answers the x402 PaymentRequired; your x402 MCP client signs it with your own wallet and calls again with the payment in _meta. Returns a token for pathways_run. A run that fails on our side gives it back; no refunds otherwise. A call bundle does not cover it.
